title: 때문에
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

**때문** is a bound noun meaning the cause or reason for an event; in **N 때문에**, a noun phrase supplies that cause. This entry is limited to this basic causal construction and does not assert that it is restricted to negative outcomes.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 때문. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicMarinerSearch/search?mainSearchWord=%EB%95%8C%EB%AC%B8&nation=eng

Korean Basic Dictionary, entry 때문, definition “a cause or reason for a certain incident”; see also -기 때문 entry.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **그래서**, que introduce la consecuencia como una oración nueva, y con **덕분에**, que expresa causa con valoración positiva. También puede compararse con otras construcciones causales como **-아/어서**.
